ENABLED_IC_TYPES.description: JSON array of enabled IC type codes. Possible values: SC (Sector), GL (Goal), CF (Framework), TH (Theme), IT (Institution), CN (Convention). E.g. ["SC","TH"]. Empty string or empty array means all types are enabled.

IND_CLASSIFICATIONS_SETTINGS.description: Indicator classification types visibility (JSON); also synced to db_configuration when configuration_sync runs

IUS_DEF_VALIDATION.description: Default IUS validation mode; also synced to db_configuration when configuration_sync runs

ALLOWED_IMPORT_FILE_SIZE_MB.description: Max upload size in MB (MiB, 1024² bytes) for XLSX/CSV import endpoints (translations, workflow datapoints, areas); default 50 MiB.

UNIT_DATA_FORMAT_CATALOG.description: Unit format catalog JSON (codes + formatting_enabled). Labels from UNIT_DATA_FORMAT_* translations. Formatting rules in API code. Seeded from unit_data_format_catalog.json.

SSO_ENABLED.description: SSO login mode toggle (platform-wide): true = SSO-only, false = local-only

IUS_GID_SEPARATOR.description: Separator character used to join/split composite IUS GID (i_gid<sep>u_gid<sep>s_gid). Platform-wide; must not be empty.
